Traffic figures are Google's own buckets ("100+", "20K+"): floors, not measured volumes, and they must never be summed or compared across countries as if they were counts. Coverage is roughly 120 of 195 countries; the rest are marked unsupported rather than left blank. This measures search interest of any kind, not news interest specifically.
